items.stem: A document passes the built-in Office Accessibility Checker. What is the most accurate conclusion?

options.text: It is a useful first pass, but some issues (e.g. colour contrast on complex backgrounds) may still need manual review
options.rationale: Correct: the built-in checker is a first-pass tool and can miss issues external WCAG checkers catch.

options.text: The document is guaranteed to meet all WCAG AA criteria
options.rationale: Incorrect: a clean pass does not guarantee full WCAG conformance.

options.text: No images in the document need alt text
options.rationale: A pass does not mean alt text is unnecessary; it may have been supplied or missed.

options.text: The document cannot be improved further
options.rationale: Manual review can still improve accessibility.

items.explanation: Correct: the built-in checker is a first-pass tool and may miss issues such as contrast on complex backgrounds.

items.stem: Which TWO techniques improve the accessibility of a Word document? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Using built-in heading styles for structure
options.rationale: Correct: heading styles give screen readers a navigable structure.
Correct: meaningful link text helps users who navigate by links.

options.text: Conveying required information with colour only
options.rationale: Incorrect: colour alone excludes users who cannot distinguish it.

options.text: Using blank lines to create visual headings
options.rationale: Incorrect: blank lines are not real structure for assistive technology.

items.explanation: Correct: heading styles and meaningful link text both improve accessibility.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of alt text on an informative image?

options.text: To describe the image's meaning for people using screen readers
options.rationale: Correct: alt text conveys the image's content and function to assistive technology.
Alt text does not affect image quality.

options.text: To change the image's colour contrast
options.rationale: Alt text is textual and does not alter colours.
Alt text does not compress files.

items.explanation: Correct: alt text conveys the image's content and function to assistive technology.
